purpose: One bounded paired A/B of the existing native optimize-thread setting on the current working-tree native lifecycle. Mutation finalization is the primary metric; query p95 schedule validity is a secondary result and does not gate running the other arm.
not_a_claim: This is a paired performance comparison with one run per arm, but it is not statistical or production qualification.
Per-job process CPU/write deltas include concurrent query-sampler and daemon-process work; they are correlational, not exclusive native-call costs.
The opt-in finalization event is emitted after the store state lock is released, but stderr output can still perturb the workload slightly; query p95 remains diagnostic only.
The P1 v7 result and prior current-tree profiles are separate evidence and will not be pooled with either A/B arm.
One pair is exploratory, not statistical or production qualification; no automatic retry, default change, or production promotion.

workload.fixture_mutations: append a unique synthetic FTS marker to selected frozen Rust files; rename one marked file, then delete it

query.p95: nearest-rank p95 of successful end-to-end search_workspace_index wall time
query.schedule: serial; no overlap or backfill; missed starts counted

workload.embedding: deterministic fixed test embedding; no inference or network

profile_instrumentation.environment_toggle: ZVEC_GREP_NATIVE_PROFILE=1; event emitted only when this is set and the cargo feature is enabled
profile_instrumentation.optimizer_thread_control: ZVEC_GREP_OPTIMIZE_THREADS=0 leaves the existing default (2); candidate sets 4. Query pool remains 2.
scheduler_fields: changed path count and rescan status
process write_bytes and CPU tick deltas across each executor call
process RSS/PSS snapshots at executor completion
profile_instrumentation.finalization_event: NATIVE_PROFILE event=store_finalize; emitted after the store state lock is released when the explicit feature and environment toggle are both active
finalization_fields: directories/entities/files/fragments optimize duration and write-byte delta
mutation counters, maintenance debt/policy, optimize decision/reason
fragment completeness before/after, acknowledgement/epoch status, error code
profile_instrumentation.concurrency_note: Per-job process counters include concurrent queries and other work in the test process; use them to rank candidate stages, not as exclusive attribution.
profile_instrumentation.post_job_delay: none; capture idle/background tail through the external runner's cgroup telemetry

sample_design.primary_metric: sum of store_finalize elapsed_micros for the single-file update, four-file burst, rename/replacement, and delete follow-up events (event ordinals 3-6); compare candidate against control
secondary_metrics: query p95 only if each arm has zero missed slots and max schedule lag <=250ms
sample_design.retry: no automatic retry; stop only on resource-guard refusal, test failure, or missing finalization events. Query schedule invalidity makes that arm's p95 inconclusive but does not stop the other arm or invalidate recorded finalization timings.

resource_envelope.execution: systemd-run --user --scope with effective cgroup verification and live monitor

interpretation: Compare the candidate's mutation-finalization total and stage timings with control. Treat one pair as exploratory; query p95 is valid per arm only if that arm satisfies the frozen schedule-validity rule, otherwise report it INCONCLUSIVE without stopping the paired finalization measurement. Freshness is reported per arm against the existing 5s SLO. This protocol changes only the optimizer thread-pool size through the existing environment override; optimize remains synchronous, query thread count and all data behavior are unchanged. Do not change defaults or production runtime based on one pair.
